title: "Exploration"

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
parks <- read_csv("data/park_weather_monthly.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
park_names <- sort(unique(parks$park_name))
default_park <- "Great Smoky Mountains"
if (!default_park %in% park_names) default_park <- park_names[[1]]
```

<div class="hero">
<div class="hero-kicker">Interactive data tool</div>

# Choose a park. Find its season.

The dropdown changes the visible traces; the built-in range slider lets you focus on a particular stretch of the decade. Hover over a line to inspect individual months.

## Visitors over time

```{r}
#| label: fig-park-visitors
visitor_buttons <- map(park_names, function(park) {
  list(method = "update", args = list(list(visible = park_names == park), list(title = park)), label = park)
})

visitor_plot <- plot_ly()
for (park in park_names) {
  current <- filter(parks, park_name == park)
  visitor_plot <- add_trace(visitor_plot, data = current, x = ~date, y = ~visitor_count,
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines", name = park, visible = park == default_park,
    line = list(color = "#d6674d", width = 2.5),
    hovertemplate = "%{x|%b %Y}<br>%{y:,.0f} visitors<extra></extra>")
}
visitor_plot |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = default_park),
    xaxis = list(title = NULL, rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE)),
    yaxis = list(title = "Monthly visitors", tickformat = ","),
    updatemenus = list(list(type = "dropdown", active = which(park_names == default_park) - 1, buttons = visitor_buttons, x = 0, y = 1.16, xanchor = "left")),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

## Weather alongside the crowds

```{r}
#| label: fig-park-weather
weather_buttons <- map(park_names, function(park) {
  visible <- rep(FALSE, length(park_names) * 2)
  visible[(match(park, park_names) * 2) - 1:0] <- TRUE
  list(method = "update", args = list(list(visible = visible), list(title = park)), label = park)
})

weather_plot <- plot_ly()
for (park in park_names) {
  current <- filter(parks, park_name == park)
  weather_plot <- add_trace(weather_plot, data = current, x = ~date, y = ~average_temperature_f,
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines", name = "Temperature", visible = park == default_park,
    line = list(color = "#e7a24b", width = 2.5), hovertemplate = "%{x|%b %Y}<br>%{y:.0f}°F<extra></extra>")
  weather_plot <- add_trace(weather_plot, data = current, x = ~date, y = ~precipitation_in,
    type = "bar", name = "Precipitation", visible = park == default_park,
    marker = list(color = "#8da99a"), hovertemplate = "%{x|%b %Y}<br>%{y:.1f} in<extra></extra>")
}
weather_plot |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = default_park),
    xaxis = list(title = NULL, rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE)),
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature (°F) / precipitation (in)"),
    barmode = "overlay",
    updatemenus = list(list(type = "dropdown", active = which(park_names == default_park) - 1, buttons = weather_buttons, x = 0, y = 1.16, xanchor = "left")),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = 1.08)
  )
```

<p class="source-note">The park selector is embedded in each chart so it works on a static site without a Shiny server.</p>
